cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Compare the angry draft with the apology I sent. When I taught you to edit, what did I say about the bits you leave out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciate the apology. Why show me the angry version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because 'sorry' took ten minutes. Crossing out the rest took all night. You're still only marking the finished page.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I'm tempted to read what you spared me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cover the words. Just look how much I crossed out. You used to need me to show you every cut; please notice these without making me say them.

reason: Use specific familiar feedback and old pupil habits to shape the exact pursuit, without attributing every obstacle to a deliberate test. B actual contribution must change the next request.
